# Charcoal

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing) · [Uses](#used-to-make)

<a href="Item-charcoal.md" title="Charcoal"><img src="icons/26.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Charcoal"></a>

Wood converted into fuel. It works as an alternative to coal in torches, furnaces and boiler engines.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Tags | `boiler_fuel`, `burnable` |
| Furnace fuel duration | 80 seconds |

Make this item using the crafting or processing recipes below.

## Furnace fuel

One item supplies **80 seconds** of burning fuel. Use it in a [Furnace](Item-furnace.md) or [Cooker](Item-cooker.md) for smelting or cooking.
